description: This file provides utility functions for app configuration and UI labeling, specifically for retrieving restaurant layout settings and generating table labels based on grid dimensions.

methods.name: getRestaurantLayoutConfig()
methods.description: Returns the configured number of rows and columns for the restaurant table grid, attempting to read from window.__APP_CONFIG__, with defaults if not present.

methods.name: getTableLabels(rows, cols)
methods.description: Generates human-friendly table labels based on grid size, e.g., T-01, T-02, etc.
